analysis.aggregate: median of paired effects; min/max describe observed pairs, not confidence intervals
analysis.improvement_pct: 100 * (1 - candidate process median / baseline process median)
analysis.speedup: baseline process median / candidate process median
analysis.unit_of_comparison: matched process pair; inner observations are not independent experiments

protocol.order: block, then 512/768/1024; adjacent variant pairs; baseline first in odd blocks
